# Riverside

Written from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md). Do not edit this file by hand. Change the tokens through the package builders, then update this file from tokens.json. `make design-md` was not run, because that command registers the package in catalog.json, which this capture must not edit.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the light theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth.

## Overview

Good for: a public marketing page with a white 64px bar, a dark photographic hero, Sharp Grotesk display type, a black header pill and a purple hero accent.

Captured 2026-11-21, signed out. Themes: light.

## Colors

The roles below are the light semantic colours in tokens.json.

- **primary (#9671ff):** `light.accent`
- **neutral (#ffffff):** `light.page`
- **surface (#f7f7f7):** `light.surface`

The home hero is a dark photograph. That treatment is not a colour role and not a second theme. The login panel uses `light.login-surface` (`#222222`) and `light.login-text` (`#fafafa`).

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack. Families: Sharp Grotesk, Instrument Sans, Inter.

## Layout

No spacing scale in tokens.json. Header height is 64px (`core.layout.header-height`). Phone header height is 60px.

## Elevation & Depth

No shadow tokens were captured. Depth on the marketing pages comes from photographs, the smoke pricing field and borders. See [style-guide.html](style-guide.html).

## Shapes

Corner radii from `core.radius`: `pill` 300px, `field` 5px, `login-field` 8px.

## Components

4 component groups from the `component` tokens of the light set: button, field, header, menu.

Measured states, crops and the full inventory: [components.md](components.md), [components](components), [style-guide.html](style-guide.html).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots. They are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand artwork into something that ships.
- Don't edit this file by hand.
